title: Actions related to PC5-RRC connection release requested by upper layers or AS layer

entities.name: PC5-RRC Connection Release Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE when upper layers request PC5-RRC connection release or when AS layer releases the PC5-RRC connection. Not initiated for power saving purposes.

entities.name: Upper layer request for PC5-RRC connection release
entities.description: Condition where upper layers request release of PC5-RRC connection for specific destination as specified in TS 24.587.

entities.name: AS layer initiated PC5-RRC connection release
entities.description: Condition where AS layer releases the PC5-RRC connection.

entities.name: Discard NR sidelink communication configuration
entities.description: UE discards the NR sidelink communication related configuration for the specific destination.

entities.name: Release DRBs of destination
entities.description: UE releases the DRBs of this destination if configured, according to clause 5.8.9.1a.1.

entities.name: Release SRBs of destination
entities.description: UE releases the SRBs of this destination according to clause 5.8.9.1a.3.

entities.name: Release PC5 Relay RLC channels
entities.description: UE releases the PC5 Relay RLC channels if configured, according to clause 5.8.9.7.1.

entities.name: Reset sidelink specific MAC
entities.description: UE resets the sidelink specific MAC of this destination.

entities.name: Consider PC5-RRC connection released
entities.description: UE considers the PC5-RRC connection is released for the destination.

entities.name: Indicate PC5-RRC connection release to upper layers
entities.description: UE indicates to upper layers that the PC5-RRC connection is released for the destination.

relations.description: Procedure is initiated when upper layers request PC5-RRC connection release.
Procedure is initiated when AS layer releases the PC5-RRC connection.
When upper layers request release, UE discards NR sidelink communication configuration.
When upper layers request release, UE releases DRBs of destination.
When upper layers request release, UE releases SRBs of destination.
When upper layers request release, UE releases PC5 Relay RLC channels.
When upper layers request release, UE resets sidelink specific MAC.
When upper layers request release, UE considers PC5-RRC connection released.
When AS layer initiates release, UE indicates to upper layers that connection is released.
